svg.title: Measured chlorophyll across the Eighteenmile lake arm
svg.desc: Five original stations; fifteen reconciled surface samples per station; common concentration scale. Original WQP CHLA records, 0.3 m depth. Lines connect sampled dates; no values are interpolated into the source table. Station order follows the study's creek-to-lake sequence. Original agency activity IDs and timezones remain in plot-data.csv. The published Table 7 n = 4 at SV-374/SV-840 remains separate from the reconstructed fifteen-observation cohort.

svg.text: Measured chlorophyll across the Eighteenmile lake arm
Five original stations; fifteen reconciled surface samples per station; common concentration scale.
Original WQP CHLA records, 0.3 m depth. Lines connect sampled dates; no values are interpolated into the source table.
Station order follows the study's creek-to-lake sequence. Original agency activity IDs and timezones remain in plot-data.csv.
The published Table 7 n = 4 at SV-374/SV-840 remains separate from the reconstructed fifteen-observation cohort.
